name: Dockfan
summary: Group apps behind one Dock tile that opens as a fan
description:
Dockfan puts several apps behind a single tile of the Dock. Click it and they rise in a fan, one after the other, each with its name; click an app to open it.

Make the fan yours: icon size, distance between icons, curve, names or icons only, dark, coloured or glass name pills, and the opening animation. The tile itself can show several apps, one app, your own photo or a folder. You can also keep macOS's own stack beside the Trash. Suggestions build a group from the suites already on your Mac, such as Adobe or Microsoft Office.
